title: Kakatarua (কাকতাড়ুয়া) - 3-minute pitch, CloudCamp 'Vibe to Production in 180 Seconds' structure
structure: 0:00-0:30 problem | 0:30-1:00 solution | 1:00-2:00 demo | 2:00-2:30 AI approach | 2:30-3:00 impact + next step
notes: Every figure is sourced: yield-loss numbers quote the BRRI factsheets in the knowledge base; test counts are from the 20 Nov 2026 runs (backend 778 + frontend 265); live test = 5 labelled RiceLeafBD photos with prompt vision_v2 (brown spot 0.60 diagnosed correct, healthy 0.85 correct, 3 wrong guesses at 0.35-0.50 abstained). KPIs are targets, not results.

lines.text: In Bangladesh, rice is the staple crop, grown on small family farms.
When a leaf turns sick, there is often no expert nearby, and advice is rarely in plain Bangla.
The Bangladesh Rice Research Institute warns that blast can cut yield by up to eighty percent, and bacterial leaf blight by about thirty.
lines.say: The Bangladesh Rice Research Institute warns that blast can cut yield by up to eighty percent, and bacterial leaf blight by about thirty.

lines.text: Rice diseases threaten harvests wherever rice is grown. A wrong guess means the wrong spray and lost money.
Meet Kakatarua, the scarecrow that watches your field.
lines.say: Meet Kak-ta-rua, the scarecrow that watches your field.

lines.text: A farmer photographs one rice leaf. AI suggests the disease, or honestly says it is not sure.
Advice comes only from official rice research factsheets, in plain Bangla, every step with its source.
It never invents a dose, never names a pesticide, and no outbreak alert reaches farmers until a human approves it.
This is the live app: Bangla first, English one tap away, with read-aloud.
The farmer picks a division, never an exact location, and takes a photo. GPS data is removed, and blurry photos are refused before any AI call.
Meta's Muse Spark model must choose from nine rice diseases. Here it found brown spot, with medium confidence.
The farmer gets five simple steps from the BRRI brown spot factsheet, each with its source, and a reminder to ask the agriculture office before using any chemical.
lines.say: The farmer gets five simple steps from the B R R I brown spot factsheet, each with its source, and a reminder to ask the agriculture office before using any chemical.

lines.text: When the photo is poor or the model is unsure, Kakatarua says: I am not sure, and gives retake tips instead of guessing.
lines.say: When the photo is poor or the model is unsure, Kak-ta-rua says: I am not sure, and gives retake tips instead of guessing.

lines.text: Three photos of one disease in one division within a week create a draft alert. A reviewer approves it before farmers see: possible outbreak, unverified.
Under the hood: photo in, AI triage, retrieval, validated advice out.
Contextual retrieval searches thirty-nine passages from nine BRRI factsheets, each with an AI-written context line.
lines.say: Contextual retrieval searches thirty-nine passages from nine B R R I factsheets, each with an AI-written context line.

lines.text: A validator checks every citation and every number, and our own MCP server exposes the same knowledge base to developers.
lines.say: A validator checks every citation and every number, and our own M C P server exposes the same knowledge base to developers.

lines.text: Row-level security on Supabase, FastAPI on Render, React on Vercel, and more than one thousand automated tests.
First live test: on five labelled field photos, both confident answers were right, and all three wrong guesses were held back as not sure.
Our targets: zero wrong advice shown, verified outbreak alerts within a week, and fewer unnecessary sprays.
Next: a labelled evaluation, agronomist review and more crops, sponsored by cooperatives, NGOs and extension programmes.
Kakatarua. Honest help for every rice field.
lines.say: Kak-ta-rua. Honest help for every rice field.
